title: 接收责任，不提前签验收
premise: 来源、恢复点、校验覆盖及升级条件明确，接班方复述并接责。
listeningTask: 区分交接接收和恢复演练最终验收。

lines.en: Handoff acceptance means I own next steps. It doesn't mean the drill passed.
lines.zh: 接收交接代表我负责下一步，不代表演练通过。

lines.en: Just to recap, source and point verified. Pending validation still blocks final acceptance.
lines.zh: 小结一下，来源和恢复点已核验，待验证仍阻止最终验收。

lines.en: Correct, sampled reconciliation checks passed already. Three large tenants remain with Hannah.
lines.zh: 对，抽样对账已通过，三个大租户由Hannah继续。

lines.en: And Lukas owns clone retry testing, right? The unchanged reference keeps its target.
lines.zh: Lukas负责克隆重试测试，对吧？不变的参考库保持目标点。

lines.en: I've got it from here for reconciliation. I'll report failures without editing results.
lines.zh: 对账我接下了，失败会如实报告，不修改结果。

lines.en: Okay, I'm available through four thirty. About twenty minutes remains our estimate.
lines.zh: 好，我四点半前都可联系，估计仍需二十分钟左右。

lines.en: I'll report at four ten either way. Final elapsed time stays open until acceptance.
lines.zh: 无论结果我四点十分更新，最终耗时到验收才确定。

lines.en: So, no claim of thirty-minute recovery. We'll review the timing gap tomorrow.
lines.zh: 那不宣称三十分钟恢复达标，明天评审时间差距。

lines.en: Evidence links and access work now. I accept the remaining validation responsibility.
lines.zh: 证据链接和权限现在都可用，我接收剩余验证责任。

lines.en: We'll close the loop after your results. Keep the drill separate from production.
lines.zh: 你们结果出来后闭环，演练继续与生产分开。
